newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH BOURSE SETS CONDITIONS FOR POLISA'S LISTING.
newsitem.headline: POLISH BOURSE SETS CONDITIONS FOR POLISA'S LISTING.

text.p: The board of the Warsaw Stock Exchange cleared for trade on its main market TUR Polisa SA insurance company on the condition that it supplies some additional information before its bourse debut.

The bourse said in a statement on Wednesday it obliged the insurer to present information about one reinsurance agreement, make clear its policy on dividends for the next few years, earnings forecasts for 1996 and 1997.
The bourse also requested information about the compatibility of Polisa's investments with the insurance law.

Polisa, Poland's third largest insurer, whose public offering late in 1995 was undersubscribed, applied for bourse listing early this year but put off its bid to gain enough time to return to black after first quarter losses.
The exchange also approved for listing on its parallel market for smaller companies paper company Kompap SA and Lubawa SA manufacturer of safety gear such as bulletproof vests.
The bourse also cleared for trading new issues of Tonsil SA and Exbud SA and approved Robert Fleming Polska SA securities house as a new exchange member.
